info.name: Event Ticket Booking & Management Platform
info.description:
Full API collection for the Event Ticket Booking & Management Platform. Covers all endpoints from docs/requirements.md, including GET /users/waitlist (an attendee's own pending waitlist entries).

HOW TO USE:
1. Import this collection AND make sure your API is running (`npm run dev`) with `npm run seed` already applied.
2. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable if your server isn't on the default http://localhost:5000/api/v1.
3. ALWAYS start with '01 - Auth > Login Attendee/Organizer/Admin (seeded)'. These log into the FIXED accounts created by `npm run seed`, so re-running the collection (e.g. for re-recording) always gives you the same identity and the same booking/notification history -- nothing silently switches out from under you.
4. The two 'Register ... (demo only)' requests are safe to run at any point -- they capture into separate demo* variables and never touch the main attendeeAccessToken/organizerAccessToken your other requests use.
5. Run folders 01 through 11 in order (top to bottom) for a complete happy-path walkthrough. Every request's Tests tab automatically captures IDs/tokens into collection variables -- nothing needs to be copy-pasted by hand.
6. Folder 12 contains destructive/role-changing requests (cancel, suspend, role change, delete) -- run these last, and only if you want to exercise those flows.

TROUBLESHOOTING 'notifications aren't showing up': this almost always means either (a) Mock Confirm Payment returned 422 because the booking's 15-minute PENDING hold expired -- create a new booking and confirm it promptly, or (b) you re-ran a Register request or otherwise switched identity mid-flow -- re-run Login Attendee to get back to the account that actually owns the booking.

NOTE: 'Mock Confirm Payment' in folder 07 only works when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is left blank in your .env (the default for local dev) -- it simulates a successful payment webhook so you can exercise the full booking lifecycle without real Stripe credentials.
